text:
Zoe: DeployBot: lease jitter on migration mig_5771 during tenant-range split at 01:03 UTC. Quiesce window in effect, auto-hold triggered.
DeployBot: [deploybot] LEASE_JITTER mig_5771 shard=shard-14 inflight=17/22 renew_fail=2
Harsh: seeing pg_lock waits on tenant_data_14. If leases drop we'll hit rollback. Lin, can runtime grab a small prefix snapshot for the hot tenant range?
Lin: yes, runtime can snapshot prefixes. cost ~35s. Recommend selective pause first for tenants 4700-4725.
Mateo: alternative is to attempt a graceful handoff to worker-standby-3 (same region). That usually avoids full rollback.
Zoe: decision: selective pause tenants 4700-4725 -> snapshot KV prefix -> try handoff to standby-3 -> if handoff fails then pin migration tool to tag infra/mig-hotfix-1.15.3 and probe extend 20s. rollback threshold: lease lost >50s or inflight >24.
Harsh: executing selective pause: ```deploybot pause mig_5771 --tenants 4700-4725 --actor harsh --reason "lease jitter"```
DeployBot: SELECTIVE_PAUSE_ACK mig_5771 tenants=4700-4725 by harsh at 6123456795
Lin: starting KV snapshot now, tagging runbook: https://confluence.redwood/internal/runbooks/migrations#mig_5771
DeployBot: snapshot_done mig_5771 tenants=4700-4725 checksum=sha256:9f4d
Mateo: initiating handoff: ```deploybot handoff mig_5771 --to worker-standby-3 --tenant-range 4700-4725 --actor mateo```
DeployBot: HANDOFF_OK mig_5771 new_owner=worker-standby-3 latency_spike=1.2s at 6123456808
Zoe: handoff succeeded. resuming tenants at 12% ratecap and pinning tool: infra/mig-hotfix-1.15.3.
DeployBot: RATECAP_SET mig_5771 tenants=4700-4725 fraction=0.12 at 6123456810
ReleaseBot: [releasebot] NOTE_PINNED mig_5771 tag=infra/mig-hotfix-1.15.3 by zoe
Harsh: monitoring locks and renewals. If renew_fail count increments to >=3 we'll abort and run rollback-hatch.
OncallBot: Reminder: if rollback triggered, follow rollback-hatch checklist and notify account teams; page oncall if >10 tenants impacted.
Lin: leaving postmortem stub and telemetry links. Close thread after 20m stable or sooner if rollback begun.
